focus.label: Viral infection (vaccinia/orthopoxvirus)
focus.why: node-2 documents contact with recently vaccinated individuals and no prior smallpox vaccination; node-3 shows umbilicated folliculocentric pustules characteristic of vaccinia; node-4 fever and lymphadenopathy support systemic viral spread.

payload.analysis: Combined with the suspicion of vaccinia/orthopoxvirus infection, histopathology demonstrates Guarnieri bodies and viral inclusions, PCR confirms vaccinia virus, and electron microscopy shows viral particles. These findings, along with vaccinee exposure and no prior vaccination, confirm vaccinia infection and exclude herpes simplex and bacterial folliculitis. All key diagnostic information is covered.

payload.prediction: 患者为牛痘（正痘病毒）感染
payload.report: 患者颈部及下颌出现脐凹性水疱脓疱，结合接触近期接种疫苗者且自身未接种牛痘疫苗，首先怀疑牛痘/正痘病毒感染。随后PCR检出牛痘病毒DNA，电镜见Guarnieri小体内病毒颗粒，组织病理见Guarnieri小体及病毒包涵体，均为确诊牛痘/正痘病毒感染的直接证据。住院期间发热、面部水肿及颈前淋巴结肿大支持病毒性全身反应；无用药史及无瘙痒使AGEP极不可能，PCR及组织学结果也直接排除细菌性毛囊炎和单纯疱疹病毒感染。综合以上证据，诊断明确为牛痘/正痘病毒感染，当前结论已足够细化，无需进一步鉴别。
